evidence.detail: No toLocaleString, numeral, or comma-formatting applied to numeric elements; PD.formatPercentage exists for percentages only
num_decks rendered as {{num_decks}} with class='n' — raw integer, no formatting
Issue author explored toLocaleString and numeral.js but noted localization complexity and left approach undecided

triage.notes: The open question from comments is whether to use JS toLocaleString (locale-aware but client-side flash) or a fixed approach like thin spaces (locale-neutral but non-standard). A decision on approach is needed before coding; the templates already use class='n' which could serve as a selector.
